message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock data built into this chat, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time in New York City, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock set to the Eastern Time Zone, or use a command like:

```bash
timedatectl | grep "Time zone"
```

or on Windows:

```powershell
Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss zzz"
```

That will show you the current local time in New York (Eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, depending on the season).
